scope: Copied production web bundle with all HTTP intercepted.
checked: leading administrator checkboxes preserve stable selected targets across pagination
clear selection works and refreshed-away targets cannot remain in a hidden selection
changing the task-label filter immediately prunes hidden targets while preserving visible selection
cross-page selection enforces the 50-target limit without dropping existing selections
members have no selection or bulk action controls and never request host credentials
host history links reopen the exact selected host details without initiating remote operations
a stale host-history deep link reports a visible 404 and does not display another host
registered hosts with and without usable SSH credentials share one selection; only ready hosts are checked
stop during credential preparation waits for the current detail and prevents subsequent host or SSH requests
multiple credentials require explicit per-host selection and transmit only the selected credential ID
one-time password consumption is explained before SSH checks and passwords cannot create install plans
HTTP 200 with ready=false is a failure and processing continues to the next host
per-host checks create amd64 and arm64 saved plans without executing and expose reviewed host, steps, and expiry
review confirmation executes each saved install plan once, using its own detected architecture
expired saved plans cannot execute and closing explicitly cancels the unexecuted plan
a lost creation response recovers the same saved plan by check and credential identity instead of creating it again
failed cancellation retains the saved pending plan visibly and prevents closing until cancellation is confirmed
an individual reviewed installation failure remains visible and does not prevent later targets
synchronous repeated confirmation sends one request; stop waits for the active host and cancels only the later unexecuted plan
uninstall transport interruption reads the same saved plan and exposes unknown outcome without retrying apply
batch node removal confirms identity revocation separately, skips bare hosts, and never invokes remote uninstall
batch host deletion has separate irreversible confirmation, preserves per-host conflicts, and never removes a node identity
Chinese 390px selection and inapplicable-target dialog fit the viewport and cannot submit missing credentials
English bulk labels, per-target reason, and 390px dialog remain usable without page overflow
